title: vtc-00: timed metadata for stream sync
description: Let clients align lobby effects, scene changes and reactions with the stream: the server advertises a reference that maps the stream's media timeline to wall-clock time (e.g. media time T corresponds to UTCDate D, refreshed as needed). How time is carried inside the media (ID3, program-date-time, RTP/RTCP sender reports, MoQ object timestamps) is protocol-specific and out of scope; examples only, non-normative. Interactive events stay on JMAP push/WebSocket, never in the video.
